name: Ostralite-GX
description: Ostralite-GX is a hydroxyapatite-zirconia ceramic composite pre-seeded with osteogenic signaling proteins and a thin film of living periosteal cells that, upon implantation, triggers the host's own bone-forming machinery to grow into and around the material's engineered micro-porosity. Over six to eighteen months the boundary between implant and skeleton becomes functionally indistinguishable at the cellular level, with the ceramic matrix continuously remodeling alongside the host tissue in response to mechanical load. Tessera Materials produces it under license from BioForge Labs, and it has become the de facto standard for skeletal augment anchoring in the mid-tier market.
applications: skeletal anchor points for heavy augment limbs
rib cage reinforcement in high-impact occupational augments
story_hooks: Counterfeit Ostralite-GX has flooded the Gray Zone clinics — it looks identical but lacks the living periosteal layer, meaning recipients' bones are fusing to an inert ceramic that will shatter catastrophically under load within two years

A character discovers their Ostralite implants have been remodeling in an unexpected direction, their skeleton slowly reshaping itself — someone tampered with the osteogenic signaling proteins before the surgery

An old soldier whose entire spine is Ostralite-GX finds the implant is now so integrated that removal would be fatal, making them a walking evidence problem for a corporation that wants its proprietary formulation back
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Combat Exoskeleton Lite CEL-3
